title: x402 alternative path: escrow flow with the auth-capture scheme
summary: The client authorizes a maximum. A first settle places a hold on an escrow contract, the resource runs, and a second settle captures the actual amount (or voids the hold). Refunds can follow until the refund deadline, and the client can reclaim an untouched hold after the capture deadline.

steps.label: POST /jobs (no payment)
steps.detail: The client asks for metered work whose final price is not known yet.

steps.label: 402 with an auth-capture entry
steps.detail: The accepts entry names scheme auth-capture, a maximum amount (1.00 USDC here), paymentFlow escrow, the operator type, and two absolute deadlines: captureDeadline and refundDeadline.

steps.label: Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (one authorization)
steps.detail: The client signs exactly one ERC-3009 or Permit2 authorization for the maximum, naming a collector contract as recipient, plus a salt that fixes the payment identity.

steps.label: POST /settle (authorize: place the hold)
steps.detail: Escrow ordering is settle, resource, settle. The first settle is the pre-resource check: it reserves the funds on the escrow contract.

steps.label: authorize on AuthCaptureEscrow
steps.detail: The default EVM deployment is the base/commerce-payments v1.1 AuthCaptureEscrow contract.

steps.label: Run the job and meter it
steps.detail: The work costs 0.75 USDC in this example.

steps.label: POST /settle (payload.type capture)
steps.detail: The second settle names the operation on the payload: capture for the actual amount, or void to release the hold. Capture, void and refund are server operations; the client does not sign them.

failures.outcome: After captureDeadline the client can call reclaim directly on the escrow contract.
The server can relay refund until refundDeadline.

steps.label: capture 0.75 USDC
steps.detail: The escrow pays the captured amount to the receiver. The rest of the hold can be voided in the same settle.

steps.label: 200 OK with PAYMENT-RESPONSE
steps.detail: The server returns the result and the settlement details.
